fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Action Phase Games’ official page https://actionphasegames.com/pages/ninja-camp/ identifies its original Ninja Camp release and shows matching cover art. Noble Knight Games’ direct box photo https://www.nobleknight.com/P/2147615491/Ninja-Camp identifies manufacturer part AKG210 and the 2016 Action Phase edition. The box and original eight-clan booklet credit Action Phase Games. Reduced to 360 × 271 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited a summer camp places a ninja first during setup; the last player to place a ninja takes the first game turn.
clarifications: Setup placement proceeds counterclockwise; game turns then proceed clockwise.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2 states both the summer-camp criterion for placement order and the last-placer rule for the first turn. Page 3 begins clockwise gameplay. This English booklet has eight Ninja Clan cards and twelve ninja meeples, matching the original Action Phase Games component set for inventory BGG 176565; later translated editions can differ.
